scope: heat exposure with alertness and mild symptoms such as heavy sweating, weakness, dizziness, headache, nausea, or cramps in a person who can drink and has no mental-status change
patterns: I feel dizzy after working in the heat
my child is weak and sweaty after playing outside
what should I do for heat exhaustion
cramps and nausea after being in the sun
feel faint in a hot room
how do I cool someone who is overheated
partner is sweating heavily and weak
runner feels sick after exercise in hot weather
response: Move the person to a cool or air-conditioned place, loosen any extra clothing, and cool the skin with cool wet cloths, a fan, or other safe cooling methods. If the person is fully alert and can swallow, offer small sips of cool fluid. Watch them closely.
red_flags: confusion, unusual behavior, or slurred speech
unable to drink or keep fluids down
symptoms getting worse rather than better with cooling and fluids
very hot skin with no sweating
